newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh president appoints new ministers, mayor.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh president appoints new ministers, mayor.

text.p: Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarbayev on Monday appointed two new ministers and replaced the mayor of the capital Almaty, an official of the presidential press service said.
The official told Reuters Nazarbayev had appointed Deputy Prime Minister Dyusenbay Duysenov as Energy and Natural Resources Minister, replacing Viktor Khrapunov who has become mayor.
The former mayor of Almaty, Shalbay Kulmakhanov, will now head the State Emergency Situations Committee.
